scopeLimits: DILRMP status is Eluru-district/tehsil evidence, not citywide parcel geometry.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point hit or miss was used to infer absence.
The municipal map is not a cadastral source and its empty/404 data response is not evidence of no parcels.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: No public geometry, CRS or stable native parcel ID was verified. State/district cadastral custody is evidenced, but open Eluru-city parcel-service availability remains unresolved.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration; serial reviewer must independently qualify any future adapter.
